system.description:
You can spend a Force Point as a Standard Action to throw your Lightsaber at a group of opponents. You make a single ranged attack roll (treating the Lightsaber as a Thrown Weapon) and compare the result to the Reflex Defense of all targets in a 6-square line originating in your square.

If your attack roll result exceeds a target's Reflex Defense, you deal normal Lightsaber damage to that target (dealing half damage if you fail to exceed the target's Reflex Defense). This attack is considered an Area Attack.

You can pull your Lightsaber back to your hand as a Swift Action by making a DC 20 Use the Force check.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Force Unleashed Campaign Guide
